reason: Thirty-six dollars for a lip balm from a website I've never heard of, that I only saw in an ad, with not one review? I've been burned that way before. I'm not going to be the first one to try it.
objection: There are no reviews at all, so I have no idea if it really works on lips like mine or if it'll bleed into my lines like everything else. And a 365-day guarantee is only worth something if they actually pay you back. Plenty of companies promise that and then you never hear from them.
would_change_my_mind: Real reviews and before-and-after photos from women in their 60s, or a friend or my granddaughter's mom trying it first and telling me it's good
